The '''Rescue of Sian Tevv''' occurred after [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] leader [[Sian Tevv/Legends|Sian Tevv]] and [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Officer/Legends|officers]] were kidnapped by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] during the [[Diplomatic Summit at Sullust]]. [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]], including [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]], attacked the [[Kappa (Imperial)|''Kappa'']] [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|shuttles]] that transferred the Sullustans to the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Invincible (Strike Fear)|''Invincible'']].<ref name="XW-TOSG" />
